Package com.hkust.marketplace.utils

Class ChatStore

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.utils.ChatStore
public class ChatStore extends Object
Chat threads and their retained message history, one thread per (Buyer, Listing) pair. Threads and messages are saved to the chat_threads and messages tables as they are created; load(com.hkust.marketplace.utils.UserStore, com.hkust.marketplace.utils.ListingStore, com.hkust.marketplace.utils.DealStore) rebuilds them at startup. All methods are synchronized because the brief requires concurrent actions to be safe.

This store only stores and returns data. Participant checks and the offers-closed rule live in ChatService, the public seam both portals call.
